The Multidimensional Success of Pixar Films Visualized

Source: vignettes/multidimensional_success_of_pixar_films.Rmd
multidimensional_success_of_pixar_films.Rmd

Overview

This vignette is to recreate an analysis on Pixar ratings that can be found here.

Setup 

library(pixarfilms)
library(dplyr)
#>

library(lubridate)
#> 
#> Attaching package: 'lubridate'
#> The following objects are masked from 'package:base':
#> 
#>     date, intersect, setdiff, union
